_comment: The editorial list of PDB entries. One line of justification per entry, per docs/architecture/115 section 4.5. `label` is OUR short teaching name; it is shown in the list and the quiz, while the depositors' own title is what the identity card prints. `family` groups entries into quiz levels; distractors are drawn from the same family, so a family must hold at least 4 entries to be askable. Ids are 4-character PDB accessions. They are never REASSIGNED, which is what makes them a good key, but they CAN be obsoleted and superseded (1FDX -> 1DUR in 2000, 1QLA -> 2BS2 in 2006; both were in the first draft of this list and both 404'd). The builder reports the replacement and refuses to substitute it: a superseded entry is a different experiment.
